_README: Campus Academic Office, extracted from the PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 Edition (External Services, printed pp. 549-576). 10 services. effective_from 2025-01-01 is an ASSUMPTION (edition year start); replace if the Charter prints an effective date. Each service lists all Charter transaction types in transaction_types. Standards carry duration_days, duration_hours and duration_minutes exactly as printed. See CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 5.2. Review before importing. Each service also carries service_scope (INTERNAL or EXTERNAL, from the Charter section it was printed in); see CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 7.

services.service_name: Processing of Application for Change of Enrollment (Adding of Subject)
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Go to the Director/Head of Academic Program for signature and tagging of subject Location: Director/Head of Academic Program Offices
  1.1. Accept, evaluate, and sign the ACE form (Adding of Subjects). [Responsible: Director/Head of Academic Program]
  1.2. Tag the subject(s) indicated in the ACE Form (Adding of Subjects). [Responsible: Director/Head of Academic Program]
Step 2. Proceed to Cashier's Office to pay the assessed fee (for students not covered by R.A. 10931) Location: CDO Cashier/Accounting Office
  2. Accept payment and issue official receipt [Responsible: Cashier]
Step 3. Submit the Original Copy of ACE Form (Adding of Subjects) to the Director/Head of Academic Program Location: Receiving Staff / Director / Head of Academic Program Offices
  3.1. Accept the fully accomplished ACE form [Responsible: Receiving Staff/Director/Head of Academic Program]
  3.2. Submit to Registrar's Office [Responsible: Receiving Staff Registrar's Office]

documents.notes: (1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy. Where to secure: Polytechnic University of the Philippines - https://sites.google.com/view/pup-citizencharter/downloadable-forms. services.service_name: Processing of Application for Change of Enrollment (Change of Schedule/Subject)
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Go to the Faculty member(s) assigned to the subject(s) to be enrolled for release and acceptance to the class Location: Faculty Member/s Assigned Room(s) based on Teaching Assignment or Faculty Room
  1. Accept and sign the ACE Form (Change of Schedule/Subject) [Responsible: Faculty Member/s Assigned Room/s based on Teaching Assignment or Faculty Room; Campus Academic Office]
Step 2. Go to the Director/Head of Academic Program for signature and tagging Location: Campus Director/Head of Academic Programs Office
  2.1. Accept, evaluate, and sign the ACE form (Change of Schedule/Subject) [Responsible: Campus Director/Head of Academic Programs; Campus Academic Office]
  2.2. Tag the subject(s) indicated in the ACE Form (Change of Schedule/Subject) [Responsible: Campus Director/Head of Academic Programs; Campus Academic Office]
Step 3. Proceed to Cashier's Office to pay the assessed fee (for students not covered by R.A. 10931) Location: Collecting Officer / Cashier
  3. Accept payment and issue official receipt [Responsible: Collecting Officer / Cashier Office; Campus Academic Office]
Step 4. Submit the Original Copy of ACE Form (Change of schedule/subject) to the Director/Head of Academic Program Location: Receiving Staff / Campus Director/Head of Academic Programs Notes/Instruction: Receiving Staff / Registrars Office
  4.1. Accept the fully accomplished ACEform [Responsible: Receiving Staff / Campus Director / Head of Academic Program ; Campus Academic Office]
  4.2. Submit ACE form to the Registrar's Office [Responsible: Receiving Staff / Registrars Officer; Campus Academic Office]

services.service_name: Processing of Application for Correction of Grade Entry, Late Reporting of Grades and Removal of Incomplete Mark
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Proceed to the cashier's office to pay the assessed fee. Location: Cashier's Office / Accounting Office
  1. Accept payment and issue an official receipt. [Responsible: Collecting and Disbursing Officer/ Cashier]
Step 2. Submit the filled-out Completion Form and official receipt to the Professor for completion of the grades for the subject. Location: Assigned Room(s) based on Teaching Assignment or Faculty Room / Receiving Officer Registrar's Office / Receiving Staff /Director/Head of Academic
  2.1. Evaluate the requirement(s), compute and give grade to the student [Responsible: Faculty Members]
  2.2. Receive the accomplished completion form, class record, andstudent's requirement(s), with a notarized affidavit for Change of grade (for correction of entry/late reporting of grade) [Responsible: Faculty Member/s Assigned Room/s based on Teaching Assignment or Faculty Room]
  2.3. Sign the Completion Form [Responsible: Receiving Officer Registrar]
  2.4. Log and forward all the requirements to the Registrar's Office [Responsible: Receiving Staff / Director/ Head of Academic]
  2.5. Sign the Completion Form and tag the accomplished gradeto SIS [Responsible: Receiving Staff / Director/ Head of Academic]
  2.6. Return one (1) copy of the completion form for the copy of the student [Responsible: Receiving Staff / Director/ Head of Academic]

services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Submit application letter for cross-enrollment Location: Director/ Head of Academic Program Offices
  1.1. Evaluate letter provided by the student [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  1.2. Approve/deny request for cross-enrollment [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  1.3. If approved, recommend cross-enrollment and advise student to proceed to the Registrar's Office [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
Step 2. Present recommendation to the campus registrar Location: Campus Registrar Office
  2.1. Approve cross-enrollment [Responsible: Campus Registrar]
  2.2. Issue permit to cross-enroll [Responsible: Campus Registrar]
  2.3. Advise student to process the permit to the University where student intends to cross-enroll [Responsible: Campus Registrar]

services.service_name: Processing of Application for Overload of Subjects
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Submit all requirements for evaluation and approval. Location: Director/Head of Academic Program Office
  1.1. Check requirements presented [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  1.2. Verify correctness of documents by checking the SIS grade file of the student [Responsible: Director / Head of Academic Program]
  1.3. Upon evaluation, recommend the request for approval of the Director [Responsible: Director / Head of Academic Program]
Step 2. Present the overload request form for approval of the Director Location: Campus Director's Office
  2. Approve/deny the request [Responsible: Campus Director]
Step 3. Present the approved overload form to the Director/Head of Academic Program for adding of units to the student SIS account Location: Director/Head of Academic Program Offices
  3.1. Add corresponding units in the student account through SIS Academic Management System [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  3.2. Advise student to proceed to Application for Change of Enrollment Process (Adding of Subject/s) [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]

services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Pay the amount for securing certified copy of grades Location: Cashier's Office and Accounting Office
  1. Collect payment to student [Responsible: Collecting and Disbursement Officer Cashier]
Step 2. Proceed to the Admissions Office and present official receipt Location: Admission and Registration Office
  2.1. Print the copy of grades [Responsible: Administrative Staff / Head of Admission and Registration Office]
  2.2. Certify the copy of grades [Responsible: Administrative Staff / Head of Admission and Registration Office]
Step 3. Present the fully-accomplished shifting form and certified copy of grades for evaluation and approval Location: Director/ Head of Academic Program Offices
  3.1. Check the fully-accomplished shifting form [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  3.2. Evaluate certified copy of grades [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  3.3. Interview and assess student's capability and skills [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  3.4. Accept student in the program and sign the acceptance portion of the shifting form [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
Step 4. Return the fully accomplished shifting form to the Director/Head of Academic Program. Location: Director/Head of Academic Program Office
  4.1. Sign the release portion of the shifting form [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  4.2. Advise student to proceed to the Director's Office for final approval of release from the current program [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
Step 5. Present the fully-accomplished shifting form for final approval of release from the current program Location: Director / Head of Academic Program Offices
  5.1. Sign the approval portion of the shifting form [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  5.2. Advise student to proceed to the Registrar's Office for transfer of credentials from current program to shifting program and enrolment of subjects process [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]

services.service_name: Processing of Online Petition of Subject
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Request for petition of subject online Location: Director/Head of Academic Program/Assistant to the VP for Campuses Second Floor, South Wing Administrative Building/Administrative Staff/ICT Offices
  1.1. Review petitioned subject [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program / Assistant to the VP for Campuses / Administrative Staff / ICT Office]
  1.2. Endorse petition to the OVPC [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program / Assistant to the VP for Campuses / Administrative Staff / ICT Office]
  1.3. Evaluate the petition and approve as necessary [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program / Assistant to the VP for Campuses / Administrative Staff / ICT Office]
  1.4. Forward the approved petition to the ICTO [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program / Assistant to the VP for Campuses / Administrative Staff / ICT Office]
  1.5. Create section offering of the approved petitioned subject [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program / Assistant to the VP for Campuses / Administrative Staff / ICT Office]
Step 2. Enroll the petitioned subject during online registration or during the adjustment period Location: Director/ Head of Academic Program Offices
  2. Tag students through SIS Academic Management System [Responsible: Director/ Head of Academic Program]

  1.2. Log request in the logbook [Responsible: Receiving Staff Registrar]

Step 2. Present claim stub Location: Receiving Staff Registrar's Office; Director / Head of Academic Program Offices; Administrative Staff Registrar's Office

  2.2. Process requested document [Responsible: Receiving Staff Registrar's Office]
  2.3. Forward document to the Director/Head of Academic Program for signature [Responsible: Administrative Staff / Director/ Head of Academic Program]
  2.4. Issue requested document [Responsible: Administrative Staff Registrar]
Step 3. Acknowledge receipt of the document Location: Registrar's Office
  3. Give logbook for the client to sign [Responsible: Administrative Staff]
